item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, an executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed whom U.S. intelligence agencies believe was spying for China, plunging the world's second-most-valuable company into a governance crisis. item.title: U.S. on verge of losing measles elimination status as cases surge
item.description: The United States is almost certain to lose its measles elimination status this week as a committee of the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) meets to assess the disease's spread in the Americas. item.description: Two days of U.S.-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi concluded Wednesday with an agreement in principle on a large-scale prisoner of war exchange, but no breakthrough on ending the nearly five-year war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion. item.title: Spain holds first general strike in 14 years over housing and wages ahead of elections
item.description: Spain experienced widespread disruption on Wednesday as the country held its first general strike in 14 years, called by the main unions over the high cost of living and a severe housing crisis.
